## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — schema file consumed by task-3 agent prompt (dd-1) and validated by task-4 regression test (dd-4). DD ownership implicit via dependent tasks.)

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json as a JSON Schema (draft-07) defining the visual-evaluator agent output contract. Required fields per SC-1:
- bbox_confidence: enum ["anchored", "inferred"]
- dom_xpath: string (nullable allowed)
- dom_xpath_visually_consistent: boolean
- attribution_class: string enum ["implementation_drift", "design_flaw", "mixed", "uncertain"]
- attribution_confidence: string enum ["high", "medium", "low"]
- scores: object with 5 named properties (whitespace_balance, element_density, visual_hierarchy_legibility, alignment_grid_adherence, intent_match), each integer, minimum 1, maximum 5
- findings: array of finding objects (each with bounding_box, dom_xpath, dom_xpath_visually_consistent, dimension, severity)

Location: plugins/dso/docs/ (matches existing schema files: component-discovery-schema.json, workflow-config-schema.json)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Schema file exists at correct path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json
- [ ] Schema is valid JSON
  Verify: python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json"))'
- [ ] Schema passes jsonschema self-validation
  Verify: python3 -c 'import json,jsonschema; s=json.load(open("plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json")); jsonschema.Draft7Validator.check_schema(s)'
- [ ] All SC-1 required fields declared (bbox_confidence, dom_xpath, dom_xpath_visually_consistent, attribution_class, attribution_confidence, scores)
  Verify: python3 -c 'import json; s=json.load(open("plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json")); req=set(s.get("required",[])|s.get("properties",{}).keys()); assert {"bbox_confidence","dom_xpath","dom_xpath_visually_consistent","attribution_class","attribution_confidence","scores"}.issubset(req)'
- [ ] bbox_confidence restricted to enum ["anchored","inferred"]
  Verify: python3 -c 'import json; s=json.load(open("plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json")); assert set(s["properties"]["bbox_confidence"]["enum"])=={"anchored","inferred"}'
- [ ] scores object has exactly 5 integer 1-5 dimension properties
  Verify: python3 -c 'import json; s=json.load(open("plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json")); sc=s["properties"]["scores"]["properties"]; assert len(sc)==5 and all(p.get("type")=="integer" and p.get("minimum")==1 and p.get("maximum")==5 for p in sc.values())'
- [ ] .test-index entry added mapping schema file to test file
  Verify: grep -q 'visual-evaluator-schema.json' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
